top_signals.title: TM Lewin pivots to casualwear as AI drives dearth of new graduates
top_signals.summary: Shirtmaker TM Lewin is pivoting towards t-shirts and knitted sweaters as the AI-driven cutback in graduate hiring means fewer young workers need shirts and ties. The retailer, which was established in 1898, has expanded its range of casualwear since returning to British high streets after its collapse into administration at the start of the decade.  [...]

top_signals.summary: The Claude maker said it and some of its investors planned to sell 825mn shares at a price range of $70 to $78.
